summary: The supplied contract was accepted and enforced fail-closed: without a concrete candidate mechanism, source files/snippets, commit hash, PIT definition, or concrete claims, no substantive adversarial claim was made.

review_output.STATUS: INCOMPLETE_INPUT — no candidate mechanism, source files, snippets, commit hash, PIT definition, or concrete claims were supplied for review. Cannot perform adversarial analysis on placeholders.
review_output.FALSIFICATION: Strongest falsification cannot be stated: zero proposed mechanism exists in the input. Any claim of predictive power, alpha, or causal structure is unfalsifiable until the exact hypothesis, features, labels, and decision rule are provided.
review_output.PIT_RISKS: Full set of risks remains unknown and therefore uncontrolled. Classic residual risks that would need explicit exclusion once materials arrive: look-ahead bias via future data in features/labels, revision/restatement bias in economic series, timestamp misalignment between signals and execution clocks, survivorship in universe construction, and any train/test contamination through hyper-parameter search or feature selection performed outside a strict expanding-window PIT protocol.
review_output.CHEAP_TESTS: No deterministic test can be designed yet. Once a concrete mechanism is supplied, the cheapest falsifiers would be (a) pure time-shifted null (shift all features forward by 1–k bars and recompute the claimed statistic), (b) random-label permutation within the same calendar structure, and (c) strict causal lag enforcement (force every input to be available only after its official release timestamp).
review_output.MISSING_EVIDENCE: Everything: exact candidate description, source commit or file hashes, feature construction code, label definition, universe membership rules, timestamp provenance, revision handling policy, and any pre-registered PIT protocol. Without these, formal coverage/PIT evaluation is impossible.
review_output.ENGINEERING_RISKS: Highest-probability defects in the absence of code: non-deterministic random seeds, implicit use of future information through library defaults (e.g., pandas rolling windows, scikit-learn CV), silent data leakage via global state or cached objects, and missing audit trail of every data transformation’s effective as-of date.
review_output.CONFIDENCE: Near-zero on any substantive claim about the (unspecified) mechanism. High confidence only on the meta-observation that the review request itself lacks the required inputs.
UNSUPPORTED_ASSUMPTIONS: That a well-defined mechanism, data pipeline, and PIT protocol exist and were intended to be reviewed
That any performance numbers, parameters, or horizons mentioned elsewhere are admissible (they are not under the contract)
That the Orchestrator will later supply the missing artifacts; until then the review is vacuously empty
